== Biography ==

The Woggle-Bug serves as Public Accuser at the trial of Dorothy's kitten, chosen for the role because he is so learned that no one can deceive him. Addressing the jury, his tone is pompous, and he struts up and down in an absurd attempt to appear dignified. He shows a fastidious regard for order in his own thinking, curtly telling Dorothy not to interrupt him because he does not like anything upsetting his thoughts once he has them arranged.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Princess Ozma]]''' — employment. Woggle-Bug's role as Public Accuser, assigned at Ozma's signal, seems to place him in Ozma's service.

'''[[DOROTHY]]''' — acquaintance. Woggle-Bug's rebuke of DOROTHY during the trial ("Don't interrupt, little girl") suggests only a passing acquaintance between them.

'''[[Eureka]]''' — enemy. As Public Accuser prosecuting Eureka, Woggle-Bug's position could indicate an adversarial standing toward her.

'''[[Scarecrow]]''' — friendly_rivalry. Their connection seems to suggest a rivalry, though the nature of it is not established.

'''[[WIZARD]]''' — acquaintance. Their association appears to be no more than an acquaintance.

''Evolution:''
* [[Eureka]] — Enemy (ch.3)<ref>Dorothy and the Wizard in Oz, chapter 3</ref>
* [[Scarecrow]] — Friendly rivalry (ch.3)<ref>Dorothy and the Wizard in Oz, chapter 3</ref>
